title: Add a shared masking layer and apply it to FindTool and AggregateTool results
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server, create src/common/masking.ts. It loads maskingPolicy.json (task 1) through a new maskingPolicy option in src/common/config/userConfig.ts (default enforce; register with overrideBehavior not-allowed so callers cannot turn it off) and exposes maskDocuments(namespace, documents) that applies the redact / partial / tokenise rules recursively, including nested and array fields. Call it on cursorResults.documents before EJSON.stringify: in FindTool.execute (src/tools/mongodb/read/find.ts:108-118), in AggregateTool.execute (src/tools/mongodb/read/aggregate.ts:187-192) and, for consistency, in AggregateDBTool (aggregateDB.ts:102; it has no ledger finding). For aggregate pipelines the output namespace cannot be inferred, so mask by the source collection's policy, and apply the union of rules when the pipeline has $lookup or $unionWith. Do not rely on the optional caller-supplied projection. Deliver as one PR against main.
acceptanceCriteria: find.ts and aggregate.ts pass returned documents through maskDocuments before EJSON.stringify (grep -n maskDocuments src/tools/mongodb/read/find.ts src/tools/mongodb/read/aggregate.ts returns a match in each)
Calling the find tool on a seeded classified collection in the dev docker compose environment returns redacted values for every field marked redact in maskingPolicy.json
A probe-schemas re-run on the PR head no longer reports SCH-API-03 at src/tools/mongodb/read/find.ts or src/tools/mongodb/read/aggregate.ts

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-schemas on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server at the merged commit. Expected result: no SCH-API-03 fail result for find.ts or aggregate.ts, and the fingerprints a051281e... and 92f6aea8... are absent from the SARIF export.

rootCause.description: FindTool and AggregateTool serialise raw cursor documents with EJSON.stringify, and nothing masks or filters by classification before the result reaches the MCP client.
